title: Free right dg sheaves on closed homogeneous generators
statement: On a ringed site small in [def-weil-size-convention], let $\mathcal O$ be commutative and use the coefficient module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and dg algebra complexes of [def-sfb-sheaf-dg-module-localization]. Encode a graded set sheaf by its fibre sheaves $(E_k)_{k\in\mathbf Z}$; the total is their sheaf coproduct with its degree map to $\underline{\mathbf Z}$. Put $G(E)^k=\mathcal O[E_k]$ using [def-trf-free-module-sheaf-construction], with zero differential. Right dg $A$-modules are module objects in the reversed tensor category of coefficient complexes. Define $F_A(E)=G(E)\otimes_{\mathcal O}A$, with right coefficient multiplication and Koszul differential, so $d(sa)=(-1)^k s\,da$ and the generator is $s\otimes1$. Define its balanced tensor with a left dg $A$-module $N$ as the coequalizer of $(p,a,n)\mapsto(pa,n)$ and $(p,a,n)\mapsto(p,an)$ on direct-sum total coefficient tensor complexes. For any graded coefficient sheaf $M$, the reduced graded free-tensor functor is $T_E(M)^n=\bigoplus_k\mathcal O[E_k]\otimes_{\mathcal O}M^{n-k}$; morphisms are tensor maps on each summand. These sheaf tensors are the sheafified sectionwise tensors, using [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification].
